# 2026-10-14

## 01:16Z — Depot CI speed/reliability investigation (Nifty `0wglan6wYT`)

- User-requested read-only investigation delegated to a subagent: did GitHub Actions speed improve since the 2026-09-30 Depot migration (commit `c0b6c3e1`, "ci: migrate Linux workflows to Depot runners")? Tracker task `0wglan6wYT` created via the canonical VPS logger (no equivalent existing task; closest, `bOGZxlfcCV`, is runner-restart tooling, not this measurement). No repo, workflow, gate, runner or provider configuration changed; no production action.
- Evidence basis (measured, verified against the saved report): GitHub Actions REST API, 15 workflows, 1,387 runs and 1,743 job records for 2026-09-01..2026-10-13, per-workflow enumeration (repo-wide 1,000 cap avoided), 510 annotation fetches, ~2,000 requests, classified by job `labels` (`ubuntu-latest` 1,423 / `depot-ubuntu-24.04` 254 / `depot-ubuntu-24.04-4` 52). Report and raw extracts: `/tmp/opencode/depot-ci-speed/` (temporary, not durable repo evidence).
- Speed (success-only medians): `validate` 969s → 806s over the strict 10-05..10-08 both-runners overlap (n=41/7, −16.8%) and 969s → 726s against Depot-only days (−25.1%, n=24); `route-fixtures` 756s → 712s overlap (−5.8%, n=45/11), 662s after (−12.5%); `deploy` 100s → 69s (n=26/17, −30.7%, p90 flat, and Depot gained Sentry/secret steps so memo does more work); short jobs large relative gains (`recover` 44s → 14s, `profile_policy` 48s → 12s); runner pickup 3s → 1s. Gains concentrate in fixed overhead (fast checkout from 10-12: 38-40s → 7s; `npm ci` 12s → 5s; Playwright 24s → 6s), not the dominant app-test step (830s → 673s on a still-growing suite).
- Reliability regression: 28 Depot jobs lost to "self-hosted runner lost communication" with zero executed steps, all on 10-12 (20) and 10-13 (8), none before; 27% of non-skipped Depot jobs on those days (~4.7h wasted, 17 blocked runs across `validate`/`route-fixtures`/`recover`/`deploy`), zero such losses on GitHub-hosted runners in the window. This is the same failure class blocking PR #170 shipping.
- Caveats recorded by the investigation: not a controlled experiment (5-11 samples per side in the clean overlap); suite grew ~4-5x across the window so all-time medians are unusable; the Depot fast-checkout date and the outage both start 10-12 and are not separately inspectable; no Depot dashboard/billing access; public-repo GitHub runners were free. Inference, not measurement: the speed gain is modest (15-25% on the main gate) and currently offset by the reliability loss; Depot net value not demonstrated for this repo on these data.
- PR #170 remains blocked on runner recovery; branch head unchanged at `9cddbebc`, this ledger entry and prior records stay local (not pushed) to avoid triggering another known-blocked CI run. Worktree retained; open parents still open.
